YM: WAIT, still pinned to the same unresolved 3-session box (52081-52722), now with a fully neutral checklist (0) -- zero edge, and the track record says this zone doesn't pay on Mondays (0% in 8 samples).

CL: WAIT, broke with authority both the 3-day ceiling AND the long reversal's own invalidation (88.42 VWAP) with a confirmed bearish BOS -- the 24h move flipped to short; the long thesis downgrades to a reinstated short, the same failed-reclaim script as the rest of the complex at the 87.59 sweep.
HIGH news risk: Fed Chair Warsh speaks at 11:00 CT, squarely inside the NY session -- hands-off 10:45-11:10 CT, don't open anything new in that window.

off-chart context: the VIX curve flipped to backwardation (real stress, not just noise) with the dollar and the 10-year breaking highs again -- a more risk-off tone than London's, weighing on gold and backing the index short side; NVDA reports tomorrow (Tuesday) after the close and the Anthropic IPO stays on the radar.
$1000 daily limit (low end) over 3 stops: none of today's zones fit in full size (big stop or weak R:R); all fit in micros with 1-4 contracts. For Jesus that limit is usually the whole account.
